versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֥עַל דָּוִ֖ד מִשָּׁ֑ם וַיֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּמְצָד֥וֹת עֵֽין־גֶּֽדִי׃

controles.web: David went up from there, and lived in the strongholds of En Gedi.
controles.kjv: And David went up from thence, and dwelt in strong holds at En–gedi.
controles.livre: Então Davi subiu dali, e habitou nos lugares fortes em En-Gedi.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י כַּֽאֲשֶׁר֙ שָׁ֣ב שָׁא֔וּל מֵאַחֲרֵ֖י פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַיַּגִּ֤דוּ לוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד בְּמִדְבַּ֖ר עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃ס

controles.web: When Saul was returned from following the Philistines, it was told him, saying, “Behold, David is in the wilderness of En Gedi.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when Saul was returned from following the Philistines, that it was told him, saying, Behold, David is in the wilderness of En–gedi.
controles.livre: E quando Saul voltou dos filisteus, deram-lhe aviso dizendo: Eis que Davi está no deserto de En-Gedi.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח שָׁא֗וּל שְׁלֹ֧שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ בָּח֖וּר מִכָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ לְבַקֵּ֤שׁ אֶת־דָּוִד֙ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֔יו עַל־פְּנֵ֖י צוּרֵ֥י הַיְּעֵלִֽים׃

controles.web: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men on the rocks of the wild goats.
controles.kjv: Then Saul took three thousand chosen men out of all Israel, and went to seek David and his men upon the rocks of the wild goats.
controles.livre: E tomando Saul três mil homens escolhidos de todo Israel, foi em busca de Davi e dos seus, pelos cumes dos penhascos das cabras montesas.

versos.hebraico: וַ֠יָּבֹא אֶל־גִּדְר֨וֹת הַצֹּ֤אן עַל־הַדֶּ֨רֶךְ֙ וְשָׁ֣ם מְעָרָ֔ה וַיָּבֹ֥א שָׁא֖וּל לְהָסֵ֣ךְ אֶת־רַגְלָ֑יו וְדָוִד֙ וַאֲנָשָׁ֔יו בְּיַרְכְּתֵ֥י הַמְּעָרָ֖ה יֹשְׁבִֽים׃

controles.web: He came to the sheep pens by the way, where there was a cave; and Saul went in to relieve himself. Now David and his men were abiding in the innermost parts of the cave.
controles.kjv: And he came to the sheepcotes by the way, where was a cave; and Saul went in to cover his feet: and David and his men remained in the sides of the cave.
controles.livre: E quando chegou a uma malhada de ovelhas no caminho, de onde havia uma cova, entrou Saul nela para fazer necessidade; e Davi e os seus estavam aos lados da cova.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י דָוִ֜ד אֵלָ֗יו הִנֵּ֨ה הַיּ֜וֹם אֲֽשֶׁר־אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלֶ֗יךָ הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י נֹתֵ֤ן אֶת־איביך בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ לּ֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר יִטַ֣ב בְּעֵינֶ֑יךָ וַיָּ֣קָם דָּוִ֗ד וַיִּכְרֹ֛ת אֶת־כְּנַֽף־הַמְּעִ֥יל אֲשֶׁר־לְשָׁא֖וּל בַּלָּֽט׃

controles.web: The men of David said to him, “Behold, the day of which Yahweh said to you, ‘Behold, I will deliver your enemy into your hand, and you shall do to him as it shall seem good to you.’” Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe secretly.
controles.kjv: And the men of David said unto him, Behold the day of which the Lord said unto thee, Behold, I will deliver thine enemy into thine hand, that thou mayest do to him as it shall seem good unto thee. Then David arose, and cut off the skirt of Saul’s robe privily.
controles.livre: Então os de Davi lhe disseram: Eis que o dia que te disse o SENHOR: Eis que entregou tu inimigo em tuas mãos, e farás com ele como te parecer. E levantou-se Davi, e caladamente cortou a beira do manto de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ לֵב־דָּוִ֖ד אֹת֑וֹ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר כָּרַ֔ת אֶת־כָּנָ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר לְשָׁאֽוּל׃ס

controles.web: Afterward, David’s heart struck him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass afterward, that David’s heart smote him, because he had cut off Saul’s skirt.
controles.livre: Depois do qual o coração de Davi lhe golpeava, porque havia cortado a beira do manto de Saul.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לַאֲנָשָׁ֜יו חָלִ֧ילָה לִּ֣י מֵֽיהוָ֗ה אִם־אֶעֱשֶׂה֩ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֨ר הַזֶּ֤ה לַֽאדֹנִי֙ לִמְשִׁ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לִשְׁלֹ֥חַ יָדִ֖י בּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

controles.web: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand against him, since he is Yahweh’s anointed.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto his men, The Lord forbid that I should do this thing unto my master, the Lord’s anointed, to stretch forth mine hand against him, seeing he is the anointed of the Lord.
controles.livre: E disse aos seus: o SENHOR me guarde de fazer tal coisa contra meu senhor, o ungido do SENHOR, que eu estenda minha mão contra ele; porque é o ungido do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְשַׁסַּ֨ע דָּוִ֤ד אֶת־אֲנָשָׁיו֙ בַּדְּבָרִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א נְתָנָ֖ם לָק֣וּם אֶל־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֛וּל קָ֥ם מֵהַמְּעָרָ֖ה וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃ס

controles.web: So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
controles.kjv: So David stayed his servants with these words, and suffered them not to rise against Saul. But Saul rose up out of the cave, and went on his way.
controles.livre: Assim Davi conteve os seus com palavras, e não lhes permitiu que se levantassem contra Saul. E Saul, saindo da cova, foi-se seu caminho.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֨קָם דָּוִ֜ד אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֗ן וַיֵּצֵא֙ מן־המערה וַיִּקְרָ֧א אַֽחֲרֵי־שָׁא֛וּל לֵאמֹ֖ר אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיַּבֵּ֤ט שָׁאוּל֙ אַֽחֲרָ֔יו וַיִּקֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֥ד אַפַּ֛יִם אַ֖רְצָה וַיִּשְׁתָּֽחוּ׃ס

controles.web: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, “My lord the king!”   When Saul looked behind him, David bowed with his face to the earth, and showed respect.
controles.kjv: David also arose afterward, and went out of the cave, and cried after Saul, saying, My lord the king. And when Saul looked behind him, David stooped with his face to the earth, and bowed himself.
controles.livre: Também Davi se levantou depois, e saindo da cova deu vozes às costas de Saul, dizendo: Meu senhor o rei! E quando Saul olhou atrás, Davi inclinou seu rosto em terra, e fez reverência.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר דָּוִד֙ לְשָׁא֔וּל לָ֧מָּה תִשְׁמַ֛ע אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י אָדָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד מְבַקֵּ֖שׁ רָעָתֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to men’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks your hurt?’
controles.kjv: And David said to Saul, Wherefore hearest thou men’s words, saying, Behold, David seeketh thy hurt?
controles.livre: E disse Davi a Saul: Por que ouves as palavras dos que dizem: Olha que Davi procura teu mal?

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּה֩ הַיּ֨וֹם הַזֶּ֜ה רָא֣וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ אֵ֣ת אֲשֶׁר־נְתָנְךָ֩ יְהוָ֨ה׀ הַיּ֤וֹם׀ בְּיָדִי֙ בַּמְּעָרָ֔ה וְאָמַ֥ר לַהֲרָגֲךָ֖ וַתָּ֣חָס עָלֶ֑יךָ וָאֹמַ֗ר לֹא־אֶשְׁלַ֤ח יָדִי֙ בַּֽאדֹנִ֔י כִּי־מְשִׁ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה הֽוּא׃

controles.web: Behold, this day your eyes have seen how that Yahweh had delivered you today into my hand in the cave. Some urged me to kill you; but I spared you; and I said, I will not stretch out my hand against my lord; for he is Yahweh’s anointed.
controles.kjv: Behold, this day thine eyes have seen how that the Lord had delivered thee to day into mine hand in the cave: and some bade me kill thee: but mine eye spared thee; and I said, I will not put forth mine hand against my lord; for he is the Lord’s anointed.
controles.livre: Eis que viram hoje teus olhos como o SENHOR te pôs hoje em minhas mãos na cova: e disseram que te matasse, mas te poupei, porque disse: Não estenderei minha mão contra meu senhor, porque ungido é do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאָבִ֣י רְאֵ֔ה גַּ֗ם רְאֵ֛ה אֶת־כְּנַ֥ף מְעִילְךָ֖ בְּיָדִ֑י כִּ֡י בְּכָרְתִי֩ אֶת־כְּנַ֨ף מְעִֽילְךָ֜ וְלֹ֣א הֲרַגְתִּ֗יךָ דַּ֤ע וּרְאֵה֙ כִּי֩ אֵ֨ין בְּיָדִ֜י רָעָ֤ה וָפֶ֨שַׁע֙ וְלֹא־חָטָ֣אתִי לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֛ה צֹדֶ֥ה אֶת־נַפְשִׁ֖י לְקַחְתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Moreover, my father, behold, yes, see the skirt of your robe in my hand; for in that I cut off the skirt of your robe, and didn’t kill you, know and see that there is neither evil nor disobedience in my hand, and I have not sinned against you, though you hunt for my life to take it.
controles.kjv: Moreover, my father, see, yea, see the skirt of thy robe in my hand: for in that I cut off the skirt of thy robe, and killed thee not, know thou and see that there is neither evil nor transgression in mine hand, and I have not sinned against thee; yet thou huntest my soul to take it.
controles.livre: E olha, meu pai, olha ainda a beira de teu manto em minha mão: porque eu cortei a beira de tua manto, e não te matei. Conhece, pois, e vê que não há mal nem traição em minha mão, nem pequei contra ti; contudo, tu andas à caça de minha vida para tirá-la de mim.

versos.hebraico: יִשְׁפֹּ֤ט יְהוָה֙ בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֔ךָ וּנְקָמַ֥נִי יְהוָ֖ה מִמֶּ֑ךָּ וְיָדִ֖י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה־בָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: May Yahweh judge between me and you, and may Yahweh avenge me of you; but my hand shall not be on you.
controles.kjv: The Lord judge between me and thee, and the Lord avenge me of thee: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
controles.livre: Julgue o SENHOR entre mim e ti, e vingue-me de ti o SENHOR: porém minha mão não será contra ti.

versos.hebraico: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹאמַ֗ר מְשַׁל֙ הַקַּדְמֹנִ֔י מֵרְשָׁעִ֖ים יֵ֣צֵא רֶ֑שַׁע וְיָדִ֖י לֹ֥א תִֽהְיֶה־בָּֽךְ׃

controles.web: As the proverb of the ancients says, ‘Out of the wicked comes wickedness;’ but my hand shall not be on you.
controles.kjv: As saith the proverb of the ancients, Wickedness proceedeth from the wicked: but mine hand shall not be upon thee.
controles.livre: Como diz o provérbio dos antigos: Dos ímpios sairá a impiedade: assim que minha mão não será contra ti.

versos.hebraico: אַחֲרֵ֨י מִ֤י יָצָא֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אַחֲרֵ֥י מִ֖י אַתָּ֣ה רֹדֵ֑ף אַֽחֲרֵי֙ כֶּ֣לֶב מֵ֔ת אַחֲרֵ֖י פַּרְעֹ֥שׁ אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: Against whom has the king of Israel come out? Whom do you pursue? A dead dog? A flea?
controles.kjv: After whom is the king of Israel come out? after whom dost thou pursue? after a dead dog, after a flea.
controles.livre: Atrás de quem saiu o rei de Israel? a quem persegues? a um cão morto? a uma pulga?

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְדַיָּ֔ן וְשָׁפַ֖ט בֵּינִ֣י וּבֵינֶ֑ךָ וְיֵ֨רֶא֙ וְיָרֵ֣ב אֶת־רִיבִ֔י וְיִשְׁפְּטֵ֖נִי מִיָּדֶֽךָ׃פ

controles.web: May Yahweh therefore be judge, and give sentence between me and you, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of your hand.”
controles.kjv: The Lord therefore be judge, and judge between me and thee, and see, and plead my cause, and deliver me out of thine hand.
controles.livre: O SENHOR, pois, será juiz, e ele julgará entre mim e ti. Ele veja, e sustente minha causa, e me defenda de tua mão.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י׀ כְּכַלּ֣וֹת דָּוִ֗ד לְדַבֵּ֞ר אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֨לֶּה֙ אֶל־שָׁא֔וּל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁא֔וּל הֲקֹלְךָ֥ זֶ֖ה בְּנִ֣י דָוִ֑ד וַיִּשָּׂ֥א שָׁא֛וּל קֹל֖וֹ וַיֵּֽבְךְּ׃

controles.web: It came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words to Saul, that Saul said, “Is this your voice, my son David?” Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when David had made an end of speaking these words unto Saul, that Saul said, Is this thy voice, my son David? And Saul lifted up his voice, and wept.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando Davi acabou de dizer estas palavras a Saul, Saul disse: Não é esta a tua voz, meu filho Davi? E Saul, levantando sua voz, chorou.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ אֶל־דָּוִ֔ד צַדִּ֥יק אַתָּ֖ה מִמֶּ֑נִּי כִּ֤י אַתָּה֙ גְּמַלְתַּ֣נִי הַטּוֹבָ֔ה וַאֲנִ֖י גְּמַלְתִּ֥יךָ הָרָעָֽה׃

controles.web: He said to David, “You are more righteous than I; for you have done good to me, whereas I have done evil to you.
controles.kjv: And he said to David, Thou art more righteous than I: for thou hast rewarded me good, whereas I have rewarded thee evil.
controles.livre: E disse a Davi: Mais justo és tu que eu, que me pagaste com bem, havendo-te eu pagado com mal.

versos.hebraico: ואת הִגַּ֣דְתָּ הַיּ֔וֹם אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשִׂ֥יתָה אִתִּ֖י טוֹבָ֑ה אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סִגְּרַ֧נִי יְהוָ֛ה בְּיָדְךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א הֲרַגְתָּֽנִי׃

controles.web: You have declared this day how you have dealt well with me, because when Yahweh had delivered me up into your hand, you didn’t kill me.
controles.kjv: And thou hast shewed this day how that thou hast dealt well with me: forasmuch as when the Lord had delivered me into thine hand, thou killedst me not.
controles.livre: Tu mostraste hoje que fizeste comigo bem; pois não me mataste, havendo-me o SENHOR posto em tuas mãos.

versos.hebraico: וְכִֽי־יִמְצָ֥א אִישׁ֙ אֶת־אֹ֣יְב֔וֹ וְשִׁלְּח֖וֹ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבָ֑ה וַֽיהוָה֙ יְשַׁלֶּמְךָ֣ טוֹבָ֔ה תַּ֚חַת הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתָה לִֽי׃

controles.web: For if a man finds his enemy, will he let him go away unharmed? Therefore may Yahweh reward you good for that which you have done to me this day.
controles.kjv: For if a man find his enemy, will he let him go well away? wherefore the Lord reward thee good for that thou hast done unto me this day.
controles.livre: Porque quem achará a seu inimigo, e o deixará ir saro e salvo? O SENHOR te pague com bem pelo que neste dia fizeste comigo.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֥י מָלֹ֖ךְ תִּמְל֑וֹךְ וְקָ֨מָה֙ בְּיָ֣דְךָ֔ מַמְלֶ֖כֶת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Now, behold, I know that you shall surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in your hand.
controles.kjv: And now, behold, I know well that thou shalt surely be king, and that the kingdom of Israel shall be established in thine hand.
controles.livre: E agora, como eu entendo que tu hás de reinar, e que o reino de Israel será em tua mão firme e estável,

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֗ה הִשָּׁ֤בְעָה לִּי֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה אִם־תַּכְרִ֥ית אֶת־זַרְעִ֖י אַֽחֲרָ֑י וְאִם־תַּשְׁמִ֥יד אֶת־שְׁמִ֖י מִבֵּ֥ית אָבִֽי׃

controles.web: Swear now therefore to me by Yahweh, that you will not cut off my seed after me, and that you will not destroy my name out of my father’s house.”
controles.kjv: Swear now therefore unto me by the Lord, that thou wilt not cut off my seed after me, and that thou wilt not destroy my name out of my father’s house.
controles.livre: Jura-me, pois, agora pelo SENHOR, que não cortarás minha descendência depois de mim, nem apagarás meu nome da casa de meu pai.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע דָּוִ֖ד לְשָׁא֑וּל וַיֵּ֤לֶךְ שָׁאוּל֙ אֶל־בֵּית֔וֹ וְדָוִד֙ וַֽאֲנָשָׁ֔יו עָל֖וּ עַל־הַמְּצוּדָֽה׃פ

controles.web: David swore to Saul. Saul went home; but David and his men went up to the stronghold.
controles.kjv: And David sware unto Saul. And Saul went home; but David and his men gat them up unto the hold.
controles.livre: Então Davi jurou a Saul. E foi-se Saul à sua casa, e Davi e os seus se subiram ao lugar forte.
